about.title: یک شرکت نیوزیلندی برای فناوری عمیق کاربردی.
about.intro: ما هوش مصنوعی، داده، نرم‌افزار و مهندسی را برای ساخت فناوری مسئولانه و دارای ارزش واقعی ترکیب می‌کنیم.
about.storyTitle: از ایده پیچیده تا سامانه کاربردی.
storyParagraphs: IndustrialOrigami.AI was established to bridge advanced research and practical commercial technology.
The company is developing an intelligent robotic hand while building wider capability in agentic and generative AI, data science, software engineering, CAD and intelligent automation.
Our method is evidence-led: understand the problem, build a focused prototype, measure performance, learn from users and scale only when the technical and commercial case is credible.

items.title: رباتیک و اتوماسیون
items.menuDescription: دست‌کاری تطبیقی، حسگر، کنترل و نمونه‌های اتوماسیون.
items.summary: Research and prototype development for robotic systems, intelligent end-effectors and industrial automation.
overview: We investigate whether robotic or automated systems are technically and commercially appropriate for defined workflows.
Engagements may include mechanical concepts, sensing, control architecture, computer vision, prototype integration and staged validation.

items.title: علم داده و تحلیل
items.menuDescription: مدل‌سازی پیش‌بینانه، تحلیل، داشبورد و پشتیبانی تصمیم.
items.summary: Data products that help organisations understand operations, identify patterns and support decisions.
overview: Analytical work is structured around a business or operational decision rather than producing isolated charts.
Projects may include forecasting, classification, statistical analysis, feature engineering, model evaluation and dashboard development.

items.title: توسعه نرم‌افزار

items.summary: Maintainable web platforms, backend services and digital products built with modern engineering practices.
overview: We develop software with clear architecture, version control, testing, documentation and deployment pathways.
Work can cover responsive interfaces, APIs, backend services, relational databases, authentication, dashboards and cloud-ready packaging.

We support feasibility analysis, architecture, prototype planning, validation metrics, technical writing, funding preparation and commercialisation pathways.

items.title: دست رباتیک هوشمند
items.menuDescription: Sensing, edge AI and deterministic control for adaptive manipulation.
items.statusDescription: The concept and system architecture are being developed through staged technical and commercial validation.
items.summary: A modular robotic hand and forearm platform combining mechanical engineering, sensing, real-time control, computer vision and edge AI.
overview: Conventional industrial grippers perform well for repetitive tasks and predictable objects but may be less useful when shape, orientation, fragility or material changes.
The project investigates whether a modular, force-aware and vision-guided hand can provide useful flexibility without becoming impractically complex or expensive.
Development can be validated incrementally at finger, thumb, palm and integrated-hand level before committing to a complete system.
technology: Force, current, position and tactile sensing

roadmap.title: Integrated hand
roadmap.description: Combine multiple digits, perception, planning and industrial communication.

roadmap.title: Industry pilot
roadmap.description: Test a narrow application and quantify performance, cost and value.

items.title: نگهداری و تعمیرات پیش‌بینانه
items.menuDescription: Machine-learning signals for equipment risk and maintenance planning.
items.statusDescription: The project requires a suitable equipment dataset and industry partner before performance claims can be made.
items.summary: A data and machine-learning system for identifying abnormal equipment behaviour and supporting maintenance decisions.
overview: Unplanned equipment failure can create downtime, cost and safety risk, but useful prediction depends on data quality and a clearly defined failure or degradation signal.
The project demonstrates how sensor histories, maintenance records and operational context can be prepared, modelled and monitored.
The system compares practical baselines with more advanced methods rather than assuming that a complex model is automatically better.

roadmap.title: Data and failure definition
roadmap.description: Assess sensor coverage, labels, maintenance history and business value.

roadmap.title: Model and dashboard
roadmap.description: Develop baselines, evaluation and operational visualisation.

roadmap.title: Pilot monitoring
roadmap.description: Validate alerts, drift, false positives and maintenance usefulness.

careers.title: در ساخت هوش مصنوعی و رباتیک کاربردی در نیوزیلند همراه شوید.
careers.intro: IndustrialOrigami.AI یک شرکت نوپا است و با افراد علاقه‌مند به فرصت‌های آینده فنی، پژوهشی و تجاری ارتباط برقرار می‌کند.
careers.opportunitiesDescription: در حال حاضر موقعیت شغلی رسمی اعلام نشده است. مسیر اعلام علاقه‌مندی به ما کمک می‌کند با همکاران و اعضای بالقوه آینده تیم آشنا شویم.

future-opportunities.title: فرصت‌های آینده و شبکه استعدادها
future-opportunities.summary: اگر تجربه شما می‌تواند از فعالیت‌های آینده ما در هوش مصنوعی، نرم‌افزار، رباتیک، سامانه‌های نهفته، الکترونیک، ساخت، محصول یا فعالیت‌های تجاری پشتیبانی کند، با ما در ارتباط باشید.

collaborate.title: با IndustrialOrigami.AI همکاری کنید.
collaborate.intro: از گفت‌وگو درباره مسائل صنعتی، پژوهش، پایلوت، تأمین مالی، سرمایه‌گذاری و همکاری فنی استقبال می‌کنیم.
collaborate.pathwaysDescription: مسیر متناسب با سازمان یا ایده خود را انتخاب کنید.

pathways.description: Explore a business problem, feasibility study, prototype or pilot.

pathways.title: Research partnerships
pathways.description: Develop joint R&D, validation, student or institutional collaboration.

pathways.title: Funding and investment
pathways.description: Discuss grants, incubation, seed capital and commercialisation support.

pathways.title: Technical contribution
pathways.description: Contribute specialist engineering, software, manufacturing or advisory capability.
